description: Returns today's REAL date in the system timezone (America/Mexico_City) as {{today_date}} (YYYY-MM-DD). Call it ONCE at the start — every date you compute (tomorrow, this week, next Monday) must be based on its result, never guessed.
name: check_current_date

timezone.description: IANA timezone to return slot `time` values in — always pass {{prospect_timezone}}.

account_id.description: Which calendar account to use. Fixed per agent — do not change.

slot_target_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the day the prospect wants a slot for. If they say 'next Monday'/'tomorrow'/'this week', convert to the actual date before passing. Omit only for 'as soon as possible'.

description: Checks live-call availability and returns discrete slots ({day, time} — `time` is local in the requested timezone). Pass `slot_target_date` as YYYY-MM-DD for the day the prospect wants — convert 'tomorrow'/'next Monday' to the real date first; omit it only when they want the earliest possible. ALWAYS pass `timezone` = {{prospect_timezone}} so the returned `time` values are already in the prospect's zone — never convert or recompute them yourself. Every response is readable JSON: on {"ok": false} read `error` and `message` and follow the message.
name: query_livecall_slots

description: Capture the confirmed choice: selected_time verbatim after confirm; prospect_timezone if corrected. Never store guesses.

variables.name: selected_time
variables.description: The chosen slot's `time` value, copied verbatim from query_livecall_slots output.

variables.name: prospect_timezone
variables.description: Update ONLY if the prospect corrects their timezone during this phase.

name: extract_confirm_details

description: Deterministic data gate - the server verifies everything and sets {{slot_verified}} itself. Call it after the prospect confirms a slot and whenever you have upserted new values. The response body tells you what to DO: read `actions` and speak each 'Say: ...' line verbatim, one at a time, then re-capture their answer via extract_confirm_details (or apply a suggested E.164 value) and call validate_lead again. NEVER transition to Booking unless slot_verified is true. Never fabricate or reformat argument values - pass them exactly as captured.
name: validate_lead

callback_number.description: Pass {{callback_number}} exactly as stored - never reformat.
